title: Lesson 4
paragraph: アカウントと日常の操作

words.meaning: a record that gives a person access to a digital service and stores their information
words.example: Create an account before saving your work online.

words.meaning: the name used to identify a person when they sign in to a system
words.example: Your username appears beside the comments you post.

words.meaning: a secret set of characters used to help prove who a user is
words.example: Choose a different password for this account.

sentencePractice.prompt: To help prove her identity, she typed a secret string of characters into the sign-in form. That string was her ____.
sentencePractice.reviewNote: A secret sign-in string is a password; a username identifies the account and a notification reports an event.

words.meaning: the act of entering a system using an account
words.example: The app asks for a code during login.
words.usageNote: 名詞は login、動詞は log in と分けて書きます。

words.meaning: the act of ending access to a system through an account
words.example: Logout closes your active session on this device.
words.usageNote: 名詞は logout、動詞は log out と分けて書きます。

words.meaning: a collection of information about a user shown or stored by a service
words.example: You can add a short introduction to your profile.

words.meaning: an option that controls how a device or program behaves
words.example: This setting controls the size of the text.

words.meaning: a message from a device or program that tells a user about an event
words.example: A notification appears when the upload finishes.

words.meaning: a file sent together with an email or another message
words.example: Please open the attachment to read the meeting notes.

sentencePractice.prompt: The email included a separate PDF file. She opened the ____ to read the report.
sentencePractice.reviewNote: A separate file accompanying an email is an attachment; messages about events and configuration options are not that file.

words.meaning: the act of copying data from a remote system to your own device
words.example: The download stopped when the connection failed.
words.usageNote: ここでは名詞の意味。動詞としても使えます。
